tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Take-home pay for an employee in Germany from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 tariff, splitting for married couples; Soli and church tax

tools.name: gross_for_target_net
tools.description: The gross yearly salary in Germany that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

tools.name: employer_cost
tools.description: What a salary in Germany costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

tools.name: compare_with_netherlands
tools.description: Take-home pay of a job in Germany (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

tools.name: tax_rules_covered
tools.description: The Germany rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources, for the salary calculators and the full income tax return. Call it before answering a question the other tools may not cover.

tools.name: income_tax_return
tools.description: The complete Germany income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: 2026 tariff (§32a), joint assessment with splitting and separate assessment, both computed; Employment with Werbungskosten: lump sum vs commuting (€0.38/km), home office, equipment; minijob; Self-employment with Gewerbes

tools.name: cross_border_year
tools.description: Estimates the employment income tax in BOTH countries for the tax year in which someone moves from one country to another: residency status in each country by its own rules (India's 182-day financial-year test, US substantial presence and dual-status, UK split year, Dutch migration year, German part

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tax_rules_covered" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
